summary: RE/MAX Holdings, Inc. entered into an Arrangement Agreement and Plan of Merger with The Real Brokerage Inc., forming a new holding company, Real REMAX Group. RE/MAX shareholders can elect to receive 5.150 shares of Real REMAX Group or $13.80 cash per share, subject to proration limiting aggregate cash consideration between $60M and $80M. Post-close, Parent shareholders will own ~59% and RE/MAX ~41% at midpoint cash election. The transaction is structured as a Canadian arrangement under the BCBCA. Board recommendation and advisors are not specified. Watch: proration mechanics and regulatory approvals; risk-arb spread will hinge on cash/stock election dynamics and closing timeline.
